programs.name: cv_weekly_template
programs.description: Use when rolling-fold errors are consistently high, as in the tightly clustered 49.76–51.57 scores, and the best amount of weekly-history pooling must be selected from the observed series.
programs.assumption: On at least six historical seven-step origins, one of the 1-, 3-, 5-, 9-, or 13-week phase templates has mean sMAPE at least 3 points below the nonseasonal median forecast, and that ranking persists into the forecast window.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when fewer than three weekly validation origins exist or when the selected template's subsequent seven-step sMAPE exceeds the nonseasonal candidate by 3 or more points.

programs.name: cv_phase_shrinkage
programs.description: Use when a seven-step pattern is visible but an unrestricted phase profile produces a stable validation error near 50, suggesting that some phase effects need shrinkage toward the recent level.
programs.assumption: Across the last 6–10 complete historical weeks, a shrinkage coefficient from 0 to 1 selected on rolling seven-step origins improves mean sMAPE by at least 2 points versus the unshrunk coefficient of 1.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if phase magnitudes change after validation, or if the chosen coefficient's future weekly sMAPE is at least 2 points worse than the unshrunk profile.

programs.name: shock_gated_weekly
programs.description: Use when the history contains isolated near-zero and unusually large observations while most same-phase values remain concentrated, making direct repetition of the latest week risky.
programs.assumption: For each weekly phase, observations farther than 2.5 scaled median absolute deviations from its median are transient, and at least 70% of the next observations after such shocks return inside that threshold.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when an apparent outlier begins a lasting level or phase regime, causing more than 30% of post-shock observations to remain outside the prior 2.5-MAD band.
